sections.text:
Ability Power 220. Damages all enemies with magic water damage.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Increases Unison gauge gains of all allies by 2 for 40 seconds.
-Recovers 15 Cost for all allies.
-Increases the max HP of all allies by 50% for 30 seconds.
-Casts 30% elevation on your character for 60 seconds.
[Unison Effect Boost] Recovers 10 Cost for all allies.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 4000
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases Unison gauge gains of all allies by 1 for 40 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 4000
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases the stats of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds.
Only [Kitty King] Cat Sith can be used as Unlocking Potential material
